text: {"assertions":["A race condition in lazy initialization of platform/config/loader.py caused a production endpoint to be used in staging environments.","The race condition bug only affected records containing non-ASCII names.","The fix implemented a double-checked lock pattern, released in PR #2213 on branch fix/wrong-environment-1.","The bug was responsible for 57 duplicate rows being written to the database every day.","The issue can be reproduced by starting the service with an unset profile variable.","Config loader tests are located in tests/platform/test_config_loader.py."]}
